products.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Core-DEV-KIT
products.summary: 32 MiB Flash / 32 MiB PSRAM；精确套件 SKU，裸模块/载板数字外设子集。

sources.title: 官方原厂镜像适用板表

limitations: 当前虚拟芯片使用 P4 rev3.1 / ECO5 ROM；硬件修订版须按实物确认，不能把该虚拟版本等同于全部在售实物。
当前为部分数字外设适配；DSI、CSI、C5/C6 无线协处理器、以太网及模拟电源行为尚未在此板验证。
此 profile 不附加 TF 卡或 ES8311；Core-DEV-KIT 没有板载 TF／音频，裸模块也不继承扩展载板器件。
原始官方出厂镜像已实际 ROM 启动，随后停在外接 DSI 显示初始化；尚无完整原厂界面／触摸验收。
精确 SKU 34679：排针、天线、相机、PoE 与附屏套件按商品页逐项区分；芯片修订版不是另一个 SKU。
3D 可视来源尚在转换；暂不宣称机械装配或屏幕原厂运行通过。
此 SKU 不含显示器；原厂恢复镜像的外接屏需求不会隐式变成板载屏幕。
3D 来源：dimension-photo-reconstruction；生产Three加载器、来源哈希、尺寸和适用部分的射线/展开复位已检验；部分结构和光学尺寸有明确限制，未宣称浏览器WebGL或实物装配通过。
Model: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Model: Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Model: No native CAD located in the exact bounded official source search. Front appearance is photo backed; internal/reverse structure is UNKNOWN and package heights are estimates.
Model: Only labeled BOOT is a physical GPIO35 hit target. RESET and unverified USER switch locations are visual only; runtime reset remains a platform action.

Model: USB-C has an open approximate mouth but no pin order, connector part or cable mating claim. FPC, RJ45, USB-A, headers and other packages visible in the flat photograph have no verified3D internal geometry.

Model: Purchased camera/speaker/PoE/10.1in display accessories are documented separately. This partial asset depicts the baseboard only and does not pretend that absent package geometry is reconstructed.

chronology.notes: Hardware release date unverified; storefront position is a scheduling proxy, not a release date.

firmwares.name: ESP32-P4-CORE-DEV-KIT · 官方原厂 7-DSI（试运行）
limitations: 官方固定原厂恢复镜像；此文件要求所标注的外接 7 英寸 DSI 显示器，只有明确含屏套件才附加对应触摸器件。
镜像原样校验芯片、完整布局、XOR checksum 与 appended SHA；不表示原厂启动或硬件功能通过。
P4 MIPI-DSI、CSI、无线从机、以太网、模拟电源与完整音频未模拟；原厂应用尚不可作为完整体验验收。

compatibility.note: Exact baseboard and package options, source manifest and selected display image. Full factory execution unverified.

tests.scope: Exact carrier profile + guest route tests; no factory boot or WebGL claim.

Actual productionThree loader, retainedsourcehashes, native geometry bounds, framebuffer rays, shellmaterial isolation, UNKNOWN label construction/exposure and inspection restoration. No WebGL or physical fit claim.

limitations: Board and packaging variants explicit. Unmodeled MIPI-DSI/CSI/radio/Ethernet/analog/audio are not replaced by synthetic output.
Source-backed mechanical conversion and actual Three loader checks are recorded; browser WebGL and physical fit remain unverified.
integrationNotes: Use esp32p4::board::waveshare_platform::profile for exact memory and silicon selection.
